author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 12/26/2018: INTC, VVPR, CUI, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +0.92%
AAPL: +0.82%
IBM: +0.35%
CSCO: +0.32%
GOOG: +0.53%
Technology stocks were rallying pre-market Wednesday.
In other sector news:
(+) Intel ( INTC ) was slightly up after a Reuters report that the company secured ILS700 million ($185 million) from the Israeli government for its planned $5 billion expansion in Israel.
(=) VivoPower International ( VVPR ) was flat as it said it is in advanced discussions with short listed parties for the sale of its US solar portfolio.
(=) CUI Global ( CUI ) was unchanged after it announced that it closed the sale of its corporate headquarters in Tualatin, Ore., for $8.1 million.
